bead.title: providers: finish ADR-010 amendments — OpenAIEffort wire format, llamaserver kwargs envelope, reasoning-token content fallback
bead.description:
AR-2026-05-17-repo finding. ADR-010 amendment (2026-05-11) §5'-10' prescribes three follow-on items not yet implemented:
- New ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort wire format value.
- llamaserver chat_template_kwargs envelope fix (currently emits top-level enable_thinking).
- Reasoning-token telemetry fallback from message.reasoning_content when usage field is absent.

Source review: fizeau-8e37e536.
bead.acceptance:
1) internal/config (or owning package) defines ThinkingWireFormatOpenAIEffort with at least one unit test that asserts it serializes via OpenAI effort wire shape.
2) internal/provider/llamaserver emits enable_thinking inside chat_template_kwargs; assertion test covers wire body.
3) Reasoning-token telemetry extracts tokens from message.reasoning_content when provider usage block omits reasoning-token count; covered by a focused unit test.
4) go test ./... -count=1 green.

Each touches a distinct package with no ordering dependency — the enum addition is not consumed by either of the other two children, llamaserver's envelope fix is local to that provider, and the reasoning-token fallback reads response bodies independent of the request-side wire format. Splitting along these seams yields three small, reviewable PRs that each carry their own named tests and full-suite gate, while every parent AC including the go-test green-bar maps cleanly into per-child coverage."}
